name: Router multicall self-target authorization bypass drives Safe modules
summary: Private DeFi Saver-style Router 0x4f0055926c839d1d960a82cbf84e2ee933958ebc exposes multicall(address,bytes[]) and treats any call whose target is the Router itself as authorized. Wrapping multicall(MODULE, [recipe]) inside multicall(ROUTER, [...]) runs the inner call with the Router as msg.sender. Safe module 0xea18b13d11f705a68f0954f637949e1eaa7ac4ca lists the Router as an executor, so it forwarded an attacker recipe into the victim Safe as a DELEGATECALL to RecipeExecutor. That recipe moved 2,900 aEthrsETH to the Uniswap V4 PoolManager for an MEV frontrunner. Copycats repeated it within 1,443 blocks against this Safe and three other Safes whose modules also trusted the Router, taking aEthrsETH, DUSD, USDC, PAXG and dust.

loss.notes: Gross depletion of the four victim Safes across 31 router-self-call transactions from block 25980525 to 25981968. Safe 0x40e93a52f6af9fcd3b476aedadd7feabd9f7aba8 (module 0xea18b13d) lost 2,965.999999999976730685 aEthrsETH in 17 transactions. Safe 0x6a1fac6b3466e29421f70d6eaa91a0de0f627ea2 (module 0xf73a5695) lost 86,631.946830531868921782 DUSD and 38,248.15816 USDC in one transaction. Safe 0xb8e12daf63314a9baa71b1e39baa4538637bf138 (module 0xd479bcc8) lost crvUSD, ASF, YND, ALCX, CVX and 0.000064083553162801 WETH (not valued) in three transactions. Safe 0xb725533606e9d0b4a07ac2b8bd477353aa8b509b (module 0xb8c74599) lost 0.701391963568975838 PAXG in ten transactions. All went to the Uniswap V4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90. aEthrsETH is priced at the DefiLlama aEthrsETH quote. The first frontrunner kept 2,882.367408826118 rsETH and paid 17.632591173879632 rsETH to the builder; later recoveries are not deducted. The PoC reports ~7.8M USD for the first transaction only.

ageReset.description: Immutable Router runtime holds multicall(address,bytes[]) with the self-target authorization shortcut; unchanged from creation to the exploit.

limitations: Not the latest age reset: the anchor Safe's module whitelisted this Router in source-4, 2.2 days after this deployment.
Router bytecode is unverified; the authorization flaw is established from the call trace, not source.

ageReset.description: The victim Safe 0x40e93a52 (owner 0xe32e3bd2ec560513cab4757564ca50d13caf9f7f) called module 0x00000020(Router, true), appending the Router as the seventh entry of the module's executor array (slot 3 length 6 -> 7; element keccak256(3)+6). Router calls into the module require this entry.

limitations: Module bytecode is unverified; its executor check is established from the 0x0000004f executor list and the call trace.

sources.note: Root cause, targets and anchor. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 25980525, index 0, EOA 0xfde0d157 via 0x80bf7db6 -> replica 0x10605ee4): CALL Router 0x4f0055926c839d1d960a82cbf84e2ee933958ebc multicall(address,bytes[]) (0x00c25829) with target = the Router itself; the Router CALLs itself with multicall(0xea18b13d..., [0x000000df recipe]); in that inner frame (msg.sender = Router) it STATICCALLs module.0x0000004f, which returns the 7-address executor array ending in the Router, then CALLs module.0x000000df; the module CALLs Safe 0x40e93a52f6af9fcd3b476aedadd7feabd9f7aba8 execTransactionFromModuleReturnData (0x5229073f) with to = RecipeExecutor 0xcb14a7ace59b7a7b19ba3fee0f3a37d23fa62157, operation 1 (DELEGATECALL), and the recipe transfers the Safe's aEthrsETH to the Uniswap V4 PoolManager (receipt log 17). The DeFiHackLabs PoC (source-6) shows calling multicall(MODULE, ...) without the self-referential wrap reverts. isModuleEnabled(0xea18b13d) = true on the Safe at block 25980524. Age: eth_getTransactionReceipt(source-2).contractAddress = Router (block 22773479, index 144, creator EOA 0xe9ecfb46); eth_getCode empty at 22773478; keccak256(runtime) = 0xc1c5927d...f3a0 at 22773479 and 25980524; no DELEGATECALL in its trace frames. Module created in source-3 (18348814:4, creator 0xd7ed6cb1), code empty at 18348813, keccak256(runtime) = 0xea4ba988...6a52 at 18348814 and 25980524. module.0x0000004f length (slot 3) 6 at block 22789102 and 7 at 22789103; prestateTracer(diffMode) of source-4 (22789103:31, Safe owner 0xe32e3bd2 executing through the Safe; Safe owners 0x8c2aecce, 0x5f411b44, 0xe32e3bd2) writes slot 3 6 -> 7, slot 0x94512809...7d22 0 -> 7 and slot keccak256(3)+6 = 0xc2575a0e...f861 0 -> Router, from input 0x00000020(Router, 1). The module's Etherscan txlist has no admin call after block 20135756, so this is the only change to its executors between Router deployment and the exploit. Earliest exercise: trace_filter(toAddress Router) in 10,000-block windows over blocks 22773479-25980524 returns 286 calls, all multicall with a module or other contract as target, from keeper EOAs 0x84513a7d (107), 0x9112d189 (105), 0x9ec86bd1 (68), 0xcffd0ced (4) and Safe 0x6a1fac6b (2). None comes from the Router itself or targets the Router, so source-1 is the first self-referential call. Source-5 (same block, index 3, EOA 0x492d2552 = the original exploiter) also self-calls the Router but moves no Safe assets.

Loss. trace_filter(fromAddress Router) over blocks 25980000-26077701 gives 55 Router self-calls (0x00c25829) after the anchor, reaching modules 0xea18b13d (23), 0xb8c74599 (23), 0xd479bcc8 (6) and 0xf73a5695 (3). For every such transaction, the Safe called by a module's execTransactionFromModuleReturnData frame and that Safe's ERC-20 Transfer logs in the receipt give 31 draining transactions (blocks 25980525-25981968); all transfers go to PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90. Safe 0x40e93a52 (17 txs): aEthrsETH 2965999999999976730685 wei (2899999999999997756820 in source-1 log 17; aEthrsETH balanceOf 53402655157601774360853 -> 50502655157601776631066 across source-1). Safe 0x6a1fac6b (0x850342386d7446e3ce479ecc246e843961a46fa6540d279a5ef602d14deb547e, block 25980871): DUSD 86631946830531868921782, USDC 38248158160. Safe 0xb8e12daf (0xe5b774f7..., 0x08bb0af4..., 0x28ee77c3...): crvUSD 2478205282638692451, ASF 209278590062852565600, WETH 64083553162801, YND 5870347661085283107241, ALCX 5768776252527970000, CVX 1744314952179387837. Safe 0xb7255336 (10 txs, first 0x118454a2..., last 0xb6409373... block 25981968 index 0): PAXG 701391963568975838. Six other self-call transactions (0x07345b2f, 0x491dea0a, 0x836ba717, 0xd07db5fb, 0xdcb03859 and source-5) move no Safe assets. In source-1 the frontrunner redeemed to 2899.99999999999775682 rsETH, sent 17.632591173879632 rsETH for ETH to the builder and 2882.367408826118 rsETH to 0xc70f00cd (logs 33-38).
